name: Meta UI Motion and Transition Polish
objectives: Add deterministic presentation-only press and tap states for interactive UI
Add bounded non-raycast modal entry and exit transitions
Add map-node feedback without changing unlock or navigation behavior
Add victory, failure, and reward choreography without changing outcomes or rewards
Measure allocations, visual bounds, and frame pacing at representative portrait aspect ratios
Preserve approved artwork, reference geometry, safe-area behavior, board rules, story routes, economy, and save data
boundary: Motion and transition presentation only: no redesign, new economy or LiveOps behavior, route change, reward change, balance change, or save-schema change.
